name: mcp-security-guard
displayName: MCP Security Guard: Tool Poisoning and Rug Pull Scanner
description: Security for the MCP servers, skills, commands and plugins you use, mapped to the OWASP MCP Top 10: tool poisoning, rug pulls (servers and plugin files), shadowing, injected instructions in skills and CLAUDE.md, secrets, supply chain (OSV), toxic flows, capability scores and permission rules, runtime guards on every MCP call, approved-server and plugin policy, and adversarial testing for server authors. Runs locally; optional paid threat feed and team policy.

threat_feed_api_key.title: Threat feed API key (optional)
threat_feed_api_key.description: Only for the paid threat feed. Leave empty to keep everything local. Stored in your system's secure storage.
